item.title: NEATEHUB, ASRLM Sign Pact to Incubate 250 Rural Enterprises in Assam
item.description: The North East Agriculture Technology Entrepreneurs Hub (NEATEHUB), an incubation centre of Assam Agricultural University (AAU), Jorhat, has signed an agreement with the Assam State Rural Livelihoods Mission (ASRLM) to implement Phase II of a three-year incubation project aimed at strengthening rural enterprises across Assam. item.description: What began as a minor scuffle between a few intoxicated men has been wrongly portrayed as a communal clash, said Mercy Khongsai, Vice President of the Kuki Students' Organisation. item.title: 10 Killed in Canada School Shooting; Suspect Found Dead
item.description: At least 10 people lost their lives in a tragic shooting incident in Canada’s British Columbia on Tuesday, after a gunman opened fire at a secondary school before reportedly taking their own life. item.title: Assam Woman Murdered with Alcohol and Drug Injection; Two Held
item.description: A sensational murder case has come to light in Assam’s Duliajan after a woman was allegedly drugged and killed by two young women. item.title: Locals Detain Two Men Over Suspected Beef in Sonapur, Hand Them to Police
item.description: Tension gripped in Sonapur on the outskirts of Guwahati city after two men were caught by local residents for allegedly transporting suspected beef meat through the area.
